canonical_question: Why is the fracture strength (3115 MPa) significantly higher than the yield strength (2709 MPa), and does the presence of brittle TiO at grain boundaries promote strain hardening or premature failure?

question_variants.question: Why is the fracture strength (3115 MPa) significantly higher than the yield strength (2709 MPa), and does the presence of brittle TiO at grain boundaries promote strain hardening or premature failure?
question_variants.resolution_summary: The paper reports a compressive yield strength of 2709 MPa and fracture strength of 3115 MPa. While it attributes excellent properties to precipitation strengthening by TiO, it does not explicitly explain the significant difference between yield and fracture strength or the specific role of brittle TiO in strain hardening versus premature failure.

answers.answer: The alloy exhibits a compressive yield strength of 2709 MPa and a fracture strength of 3115 MPa with 11.4% total fracture strain. Excellent mechanical properties are attributed to solid solution strengthening, grain boundary strengthening, and precipitation strengthening from TiO particles. The text does not explicitly resolve the mechanism for the gap between yield and fracture strength or the specific contribution of TiO brittleness to strain hardening.
answers.measurement_outcome: Yield strength: 2709 MPa, Fracture strength: 3115 MPa
answers.mechanism: Solid solution, grain boundary, and precipitation strengthening
answers.boundary_limitation: No explicit explanation for yield-fracture gap or TiO brittleness role
evidence_spans: A NbMoTaWVTi refractory high entropy alloy (HEA) has been successfully synthesized by mechanical alloying (MA) and spark plasma sintering (SPS).
It is observed that only two types of body-centered cubic (BCC) solid solutions are formed in the powders after ball milling for 40 h.
However, a new face-centered cubic (FCC) precipitated phase is observed in the BCC matrix of bulk material consolidated by SPS.

source_evidence_spans: The alloy exhibits compressive yield strength of 2709 MPa, fracture strength of 3115 MPa, and total fracture strain of 11.4% at ambient temperature.
